Protector

You see who needs shelter and step into the space between them and harm.

Rules

Agreed: minimum 0 in Fortitude, Reason; HP contribution +5. No multiclassing.

Starting disciplines: choose two distinct rank-1 disciplines from Armor, Guard, Arms, Medicine.

Discipline pricing: Home: Armor, Guard. Adjacent: Arms, Medicine. All others Foreign; no Opposed disciplines.

Choose one class-exclusive signature at levels 1, 3 and 7. Extra signatures cost 2/4/8 DP. No discipline requirements.

Level 1 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.f00b4e043daa424d.JournalEntryPage.00eb1f2e385d3a92]{Between Them} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.1fcad5b66e5c3862.JournalEntryPage.9b1485f21e78601e]{Set Your Feet} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.3ae7cb8d6c9adf92.JournalEntryPage.b7e69bd04d8917b1]{Close the Gap}

Level 3 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.6876d351268bd4cb.JournalEntryPage.d8119e194d423109]{Break Their Advance} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.096fa156eca0a693.JournalEntryPage.70ef02f3a0dabb81]{Shelter the Fallen} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.3aab51a452a040cf.JournalEntryPage.b29d58a57c279c1c]{Make a Refuge}

Level 7 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b6882f2733858733.JournalEntryPage.4e0345c3173c4f5d]{Unbroken Passage} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.579d8153e566d026.JournalEntryPage.b6ff23b47b4434ba]{Defiant Rescue} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.ba77cef7bdaeb81c.JournalEntryPage.2738a6a087c9fec4]{Drive Back the Circle}

Signature identity in play

The revised options aim for these moments, with a deliberate advantage over shared cards of their tier. Each is an independent choice, not a progression chain.

- Level 1: Intercept, anchor, or arrive ready to defend. - Level 3: Push an attacker back, extract the fallen, or make a refuge. - Level 7: Charge into a strike, clear the circle, or escort companions through danger.

Starting coin contribution: +5 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
